title: Evicted pod logs
description: Eviction events from the Kubernetes API next to the logs each shipper captured for the evicted pod.

panels.title: Kubelet evictions per namespace
panels.description: Counts Evicted events from the kubelet (node pressure, ephemeral-storage limits). Eviction-API evictions (drain, autoscaler, Karpenter) emit no Evicted event; see the Killing panel.

panels.title: Eviction and termination events
panels.description: Evicted = kubelet eviction. Killing without a preceding Evicted = API deletion or eviction (drain, autoscaler, rollout). Preempting / TaintManagerEviction = scheduler and taint evictions.

panels.title: Last lines of $pod ($shipper)
panels.description: Newest first. The SIGTERM / exit lines at the top are what a slow shipper loses.

panels.title: Lines received for $pod, by shipper
panels.description: Same pod, different shippers. A shorter bar is lines that shipper lost.

panels.title: Eviction API calls (audit log)
panels.description: Every pods/eviction request from the API server audit log: 201 = evicted, 429 = refused by a PodDisruptionBudget. The only record of who drained or evicted a pod.

panels.title: Pod terminal state from the API (pod-lifecycle)
panels.description: Written by the pod-lifecycle watcher, independent of the log files. disruption = EvictionByEvictionAPI | TerminationByKubelet | PreemptionByScheduler | DeletionByTaintManager. 'last lines' is the container termination message (FallbackToLogsOnError), which survives when the log file does not.

targets.expr: {container="watch", shipper="fluent-bit"} | json pod_name="pod", ns="namespace", lifecycle="lifecycle", phase="phase", reason="reason", msg="message", disruption="disruption.reason", last="containers[0].lastLines" | ns="$namespace" | phase="Failed" or lifecycle="DELETED" | line_format "{{.lifecycle}} {{.pod_name}} phase={{.phase}} reason={{.reason}} disruption={{.disruption}} {{.msg}} | last lines: {{.last}}"
